commits.reason: Advisor iteration pricing and model ACL depend on gpt-load scheduler/receipt architecture; not a portable commit for AxonHub pricing.

commits.title: fix(antigravity): distinguish quota window labels (#907)
commits.reason: Antigravity subscription quota-window presentation; no matching subscription observation schema in this gateway.

commits.title: fix: prevent stale values when switching edit drawer records (#7989)
commits.reason: New API key/redemption/model drawers and expiry contract differ; no related drawer transplant.

commits.title: fix(logging): 隐藏访问日志中的查询凭据 (#7972)
commits.reason: internal/server/middleware/access_log.go records URL.Path only, never RawQuery.

commits.title: fix(channels): preserve advanced custom body passthrough settings (#7971)
commits.reason: New API advanced JSON passthrough drawer fields do not map to AxonHub ChannelSettings/body override operations.

commits.title: feat(billing): bill OpenAI 12-hour prompt cache writes at their own price (#7965)
commits.reason: 12-hour cache-write pricing is a new New API billing-expression contract; AxonHub retains total cache writes but has no matching 12-hour price slot. Not claimed as covered.

commits.title: fix(relay): keep the client's JSON Schema property order
commits.reason: AxonHub tool Parameters/ParametersJsonSchema use json.RawMessage; native body passthrough retains schema key order. No relaykit map round-trip.

commits.title: fix(usage): preserve interactions token semantics when merging stream usage
commits.reason: CPA interactions plugin TokenBreakdown contract absent; AxonHub per-protocol usage conversion remains authoritative.

commits.title: fix(api): add RESP protocol bounds validation and connection panic recovery
commits.reason: CPA Redis RESP multiplexer/home certificate path absent; HTTP/WebSocket bounds unchanged.

commits.title: fix(schema): preserve Gemini $ref sibling constraints
commits.reason: Native Gemini ParametersJsonSchema is raw, so $ref sibling constraints remain intact. Antigravity uses a separate restricted-schema sanitizer; its allOf flattening is not claimed equivalent to JSON Schema preservation.

commits.title: fix(gemini/vertex): preserve non-content finish reasons and surface prompt blocks
commits.reason: Existing Gemini candidate finish-reason conversion covers partless refusal; added explicit no-candidate promptFeedback rejection in HTTP and SSE paths. CPA pending usage/translation state is not transplanted.

commits.title: fix(gemini): populate token limits in Gemini model catalog responses
commits.reason: CPA /v1beta model registry response enhancement; not the AxonHub model catalog API.

commits.title: fix(signature): sign the first Gemini function call after a text part
commits.reason: CPA native signature sanitizer and bypass insertion absent; preserve actual signatures and existing AxonHub role/tool conversion.

commits.title: fix(claude): preserve tool arguments for implicitly open empty object schemas
commits.reason: AxonHub tool arguments are preserved; no CPA parameterless-schema cleaner replaces implicitly open object arguments with {}.

commits.title: fix(codex): map commentary phase messages to thinking blocks in Claude response translator
commits.reason: Commentary-to-thinking changes visible content semantics and replay signatures; preserve distinct commentary and reasoning instead of reclassifying client-visible text.

commits.title: Merge pull request #6903 from router-for-me/home

commits.title: feat(codex): ignore use_siwc and enforce non-SIWC credentials for Codex client requests
commits.reason: CPA SIWC credential eligibility/conductor is absent; no use_siwc or credential-selection policy imported.

commits.title: fix(gemini): enable server-side tool invocations when mixing built-in and function tools
commits.reason: Mixed native Gemini hosted tools and function declarations now set includeServerSideToolInvocations; explicitly removed on Antigravity.

commits.title: fix(pluginhost): pass decoded request body to frontend auth plugins
commits.reason: CPA frontend-auth plugin ABI absent; no decoded request plugin contract to update.

commits.title: test(pluginhost,handlers): fix flaky races in plugin load and stream cancel tests
commits.reason: CPA plugin host lifecycle and its flaky tests absent.

commits.title: fix(usage): propagate claude usage.speed into response service tier
commits.reason: usage.speed pricing requires mapping Anthropic fast/standard into AxonHub price tiers; not blindly substituted for service_tier. Existing fast request support retained.

commits.title: fix(management): read Handler.cfg under h.mu in OAuth login flows and token save helpers
commits.reason: CPA management Handler.cfg mutex and OAuth token-save helpers absent.

commits.title: fix(watcher): preserve file credentials when auth directory is unreadable during full scan
commits.reason: CPA filesystem credential watcher absent; AxonHub credentials are database-owned.

commits.title: test(translator): skip replay target model allocation budget test under race detector
commits.reason: CPA allocation microbenchmark is absent; no test skip introduced.

commits.title: fix(responses): add context_length_exceeded code to Claude prompt overflow stream errors
commits.reason: Anthropic HTTP and SSE prompt-is-too-long errors acquire context_length_exceeded only when no explicit provider code exists.

commits.title: fix(translator): keep tool_use-deferred Claude web search open across tool outputs
commits.reason: CPA deferred Claude web-search state machine differs; preserve AxonHub provider extension/tool result representation instead of transplanting translator state.

commits.title: fix(vertex): use regional endpoint hosts for multi-region us and eu locations
commits.reason: llm/vertex/executor.go already selects aiplatform.us/eu.rep.googleapis.com for multi-region locations; configured Gemini base URL prefixes are also retained.

commits.title: fix(auth): skip token rejection and refresh for request-scoped 401 rules
commits.reason: CPA auth-conductor request-scoped 401 override rules absent; do not weaken credential rejection globally.

commits.title: fix(claude): validate cloak_mode never headers against configured defaults
commits.reason: CPA cloak_mode never and device profile header policy absent; preserve explicit AxonHub client identity settings.

commits.title: fix(claude): map model_context_window_exceeded to incomplete max_output_tokens on responses
commits.reason: Anthropic model_context_window_exceeded now maps to length in streamed and nonstreamed conversion; Responses renders incomplete/max_output_tokens.
